response.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, si.phasefactor AS phase, AVG(s.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.scancount >= 11 GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.phasefactor ORDER BY avg_pressratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Unmatched scans are dropped by an inner join, and sites with a NULL phasefactor form their own group rather than being removed.
AVG ignores NULL pressratio values, and a group whose pressratio values are all NULL sorts last. scancount needs no extra NULL handling because the scancount >= 11 filter already excludes NULLs.

alternatives.interpretation: Drop scans whose site has no phase label, so groups with a NULL phasefactor are excluded entirely.
alternatives.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, si.phasefactor AS phase, AVG(s.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.scancount >= 11 AND si.phasefactor IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.phasefactor ORDER BY avg_pressratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
